brief: A planter cell fed by a vertical water riser through the floor, with a bin made for the pipe.

requirements.evidence: Single full cell (piece:0,0,0;full) holding bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain-pvc, filled with soil and planted with basil (prop:1); check_build passes and the plant is visible from above/side.

riser:0,0,0 passes vertically through the cell floor, and the -pvc bin bore is built to receive that pipe. Actual water delivery, flow rate and waterproof sealing are not checked by the configurator (fit only), so feeding performance itself cannot be verified here.
requirements.requirement: Fed by a vertical water riser through the floor

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain-pvc is the full-depth drained bin with a PVC bore made for a vertical riser through the floor, seated in the same cell as the riser.
requirements.requirement: A bin made for the pipe

finish.summary: Built a single-cell planter: full hex cell with a vertical riser through its floor, a full-depth drained PVC-bore bin seated over the riser, soil and a harvest-size basil plant. House rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints); check_build passes with meshClash clear and no prop warnings.

events.text: Planter with a pipe-through-floor bin and vertical riser — I'll check the current build and locate the pipe-bin and riser options.
